description: Ask a question in plain words ("What changed on nike.com this week?", "Is the PS5 Pro back in stock anywhere?", "Which GPUs dropped in price this month?"). Answered only from public Monity Network change records, each claim numbered [n] to its record in citations (with its page, values, date and evidence link). If Network has no coverage it says so (noCoverage) and gives requestUrl to ask for a tracker; it never answers from general knowledge. Relay citations to the person.
name: ask_network
title: Ask Monity Network
